name: 图文帖子
description: 从一个主题写出一篇图文：大纲 → 正文 → 配图方案 → 照片 → 导出。平台决定篇幅和语气，每一步都可以回看、修改、重跑。 / Write an illustrated post from a topic: outline → draft → image plan → photos → export. The platform sets length and tone. Every step can be reviewed, edited and re-run.

topic.description: 文章主题，例如：为什么猫喜欢纸箱 / What the post is about, e.g. why cats love boxes

platform.description: 发布平台：xiaohongshu 小红书，wechat 公众号，blog 博客。决定篇幅和语气 / Where it will be published. Sets length and tone

audience.description: 目标读者 / Who the post is for
audience.default: 对这个话题好奇的普通读者

style.description: 风格和语气，例如：口语、温柔、有干货 / Tone and style, e.g. conversational, warm, practical

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English。决定大纲、正文、配图说明和导出日志的语言 / Output language: zh or en. Sets the language of the outline, draft, image notes and the export log

stages.name: 大纲
stages.description: 按平台和读者列出发文结构：标题、各段要讲什么、收尾。 / Plan the post for the platform and audience: title, what each section covers, and the ending.

stages.name: 正文
stages.description: 按大纲写成可以发出去的正文。篇幅和语气随平台变化。 / Write a publishable draft from the outline. Length and tone follow the platform.

stages.name: 配图
stages.description: 为正文列出每张图的用途、可直接用于图像模型的画面描述，以及替代文本。 / List each image's purpose, a scene description usable as an image-model prompt, and alt text.

stages.name: 照片
stages.description: 按配图方案准备照片。缺的图导出时会用画面描述占位。 / Add photos for the image plan. Missing files become placeholders that show the scene description.

executor.instructions: 把照片放进 photos/，文件名对应 images.json 里每张图的 file 字段。缺的图导出时会用画面描述做成占位，所以也可以先放一个空的 photos/ 文件夹（mkdir photos）。 / Put photos in photos/, named after each image's file field in images.json. Missing images become placeholders with the scene description on export, so an empty photos/ folder (mkdir photos) also works.

stages.name: 导出
stages.description: 把标题、正文和照片合成 post.md 与 post.html。没有照片的位置用画面描述占位。 / Assemble the title, body and photos into post.md and post.html. A missing photo becomes a placeholder with its scene description.
